# Data sources

All files in `raw/` are verbatim API responses (gzip-compressed JSON), cached by `code/run_all.py`.

- Provider: National Energy System Operator (NESO), Carbon Intensity API for Great Britain
- Documentation: https://carbon-intensity.github.io/api-definitions/
- National endpoint: `https://api.carbonintensity.org.uk/intensity/{start}/{end}` (fields: forecast, actual; gCO2/kWh; 30-minute slots)
- Regional endpoint: `https://api.carbonintensity.org.uk/regional/intensity/{start}/{end}` (field: forecast only)
- Latency probe endpoint: `https://api.carbonintensity.org.uk/intensity/{start}/fw24h`
